user.title: Connect Dogtra Smart NoBark Collar
user.description:
Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Dogtra Smart NoBark collar (you can set this up even while the collar is turned off).

Discovered BLE devices nearby: {discovered_devices}

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Dogtra Smart NoBark Collar
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up **{name}** (`{address}`) in Home Assistant?

error.invalid_mac: Please enter a valid 6-byte Bluetooth MAC address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This Dogtra collar is already configured.

init.title: Dogtra Smart NoBark Protocol & Polling Settings
init.description: Leave UUIDs blank and byte offsets at -1 to use automatic GATT discovery and heuristic packet decoding. Once your collar connects, inspect the 'Last BLE Packet' diagnostic entity or Download Diagnostics to fine-tune offsets if needed.

data.poll_command_hex: Optional Status Poll Command (Hex, e.g. AA5501)
